name: Jiaan Guo / Jack Guo
headline: Applied AI, Data & Full-Stack Engineer
introduction: Senior at New York University studying Data Science and Mathematics with a minor in Computer Science (Class of 2027). I build production data pipelines, auditable AI workflows, and full-stack software systems—turning messy real-world data and ambiguous requirements into tested, deterministic, and scalable products.

Across internships at Sustentra, GigaCloud Technology, and CITIC Securities, I’ve shipped AWS/OpenAI document-intelligence pipelines, FastAPI + React/TypeScript web applications with PostgreSQL multi-tenant isolation, 100k+-row logistics cost-driver models, and client-facing financial strategy analyses. Outside of internships, I engineer large-scale ML and agentic systems such as ChessLens (10.64M games / 718.56M moves) and a multi-party LLM-routing Discord agent.
Targeting 2027 New Grad roles in Applied AI / Software Engineering, Data & ML Infrastructure, and Quantitative / Business Analytics.

education.degree: B.A. in Data Science and Mathematics
